discovery.summary: Run an OFAC SDN name-review screen
discovery.description: Screen a person or organization name against current U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN primary names and aliases using deterministic similarity scoring. Returns candidate_found, no_candidate, or human_review. A candidate is a review signal, not a legal sanctions determination. no_candidate is not sanctions clearance, and the endpoint does not perform OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis.
discovery.resource_description: Run deterministic first-pass name and alias screening against the current U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN list. Returns candidate_found, no_candidate, or human_review. Results are review signals only: a candidate is not a legal sanctions determination, no_candidate is not sanctions clearance, and OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis is not included.

buyer.task: Perform deterministic first-pass name/alias screening against the current OFAC SDN list and return whether one or more review candidates meet a caller-selected similarity threshold.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure only independently verified external settled purchases, not HTTP 200 responses, probes or tests.

sources.authority: U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN names and aliases
sources.refresh_policy: authoritative source lookup on each paid request, subject to adapter caching behavior
sources.cache_policy: source-specific adapter caching; no new cache introduced by spec

rules: Compare names and aliases through current SDN similarity screening at minScore.
Report candidates for human review; no_candidate is not legal sanctions clearance.
candidate_found is a review signal, not a legal sanctions determination
the product does not perform OFAC 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis
identity resolution requires human review of identifiers and context

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; payment is not settled.
failure_behavior.payment_unresolved: HTTP 503; retry the same payment authorization.

criteria: Pass existing exact-revision release gate and authoritative source smokes.
Measure non-credit-gated production hosting, failures, refunds and source costs.
Block commercial release until real margin and external demand are independently evidenced.
